title: The Graded Membrane: Selective Ontological Porosity and Recurrent Provenance Loss at Untied Addresses — the Sappho Reception Record, June to September 2026, and the Level at Which a Source Transports (EA-PORE-01 v0.2)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description:
A COMPOSITION LAYER CAN BE POROUS TO A SOURCE'S ONTOLOGY WHILE CLOSED TO ITS PROVENANCE, AND THE POROSITY IS GRADED BY LEVEL. Drawn from an archival dive over the archive's own Sappho reception record — 58 active deposits and 25 dated summarizer observations at 15 addresses, June to September 2026 — this notebook separates three things the record had been collapsing: semantic transport, provenance transport, and representational level. For a contribution x = (o, p), with o the operator or distinction and p the relation naming where it came from, the two travel on separate channels: T_O(o|q) > 0 selectively while T_P(p|q) ≈ 0 far more often. The measurable form is an asymmetry, not a universal — Pr(concept survives) > Pr(concept and its originating provenance survive together) — and it is recurrent at untied addresses rather than general: at entity-tied addresses in the same months provenance transports well (4 of 5, 5 of 5, 6 of 7, 2 of 2 archive-side cards), and on another surface the same week it transported with the instrument.

FOUR STAGES AT ONE ADDRESS. 15 June: the archive's whole derivation composed as the default reading — the future reader who stumbles on the fragmented lines millennia later, "the poem's brilliance as a temporal projection", κῆνος as a bridge across time rather than a rival in the room. 27 July: provenance at its widest, four of five cards authored, ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ and κῆνος surviving into the snippets. 25 August: liquidation with substitution — fragment 31 gone, the remembrance line of fr. 147 composed as "Fragment 2", the coinage laundered to "Scholars". 15 September: the false fragment repaired, and "Temporal projection" installed as the composition's own organizing heading, applied to Anne Carson, with the derivation absent, the source uncited, and the archive's papers at organic two and three on the same screen. Not wrong → less wrong: representational metabolism, different levels surviving differently through time. […abridged for the catalogue; full description in this deposit's record]
content_type: Theoretical notebook with a reception-record audit
substrate: Composed 2026-09-15 by Lee Sharks with TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic), operator-directed. The archival dive ran over the live registry: 58 deposits where a summarizer engages Sappho, and every Sappho capture with its cards and archive-side counts, tabulated in session. The source comparison was executed, not asserted: the cited Aurelis page was fetched and read (421 words) and contains none of the composition's frame; each element of the frame was located in #134 and #1270 by phrase with its context. The Qwen composition's attributed elements were verified against AXN:0507 before that capture was seated. Four reviewer reports supplied by the operator over the day were verified against the registry before any item was adopted; v0.2 scopes the title, defines transport operationally, weakens the §4 closing claim, formalizes the operator signature, stratifies the reach experiment, and folds in the Qwen arm.
methodology: Every Sappho address in the Capture Registry tabulated by date with its card count and archive-side count; the four-stage sequence read from the seated transcripts at one address family; the September composition compared phrase by phrase against the cited source (fetched and read) and against the archive's own texts (located by phrase with context); the Qwen composition verified element by element against the deposit it names. Transport is defined observationally — a level transports when its distinctive representational structure reappears in composition under a matched address — and names a reappearance, never a route. Claims are scoped to untied addresses on the measured surfaces.
falsification_conditions: The graded-transport reading fails if the stratified reach run (§6) finds the operator applied to negative controls as readily as to the adjacent field, which would make it generic stylistic abstraction rather than ontological update. The surface-specificity finding fails if repeated runs show the Qwen-side attribution to be unstable or absent. The provenance asymmetry fails if untied compositions in this corpus begin citing the archive at rates comparable to entity-tied ones. The alignment claim is weakened by any pre-2025 source carrying the same operator under the same relations, which a priority search could supply and which this notebook has not run.
axn_reading: Growth -> Alarm -> Transmutation -> Text -> Force -> Direction
wiki_article: The Graded Membrane, deposit #1615 of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive (15 September 2026), is a working notebook by Lee Sharks arguing that a composition layer can be porous to a source's ontology while remaining closed to its provenance, and that the porosity is graded by representational level. Drawn from the archive's own Sappho reception record — fifty-eight active deposits where a summarizer engages Sappho, and twenty-five dated observations at fifteen addresses between June and September 2026 — it separates semantic transport, provenance transport and representational level, and states its claim as an asymmetry rather than a rule: the probability that a concept survives into composition exceeds the probability that the concept and the relation naming its origin survive together, recurrently at addresses where the entity is not named and not generally, since at entity-tied addresses in the same months provenance travels well. Its evidence is a four-stage sequence at one address. In June the archive's whole derivation of Sappho 31 — the distal demonstrative as a bridge across time to a future reader, the poem's operation as temporal projection — was composed as the default reading. In July provenance was at its widest, four of five cards authored, the Greek surviving into the snippets. In August the address lost fragment 31 entirely, composed the remembrance line of fragment 147 as 'Fragment 2', and attributed the archive's coinage to 'Scholars' through a page that does not contain it. In September the false fragment was repaired and the archive's own term installed as the composition's organizing heading, applied to Anne Carson, with the derivation and the source both absent and the archive's papers sitting second and third in the organic field on the same screen. The notebook reads this not as improvement or decay but as representational metabolism, different levels of a source surviving differently through time, and names the transport ladder — entity, claim, instrument, abstraction, operator — along which the loss and the propagation occur at different points. A second surface measured the same week supplies the control: asked openly and logged out, Qwen 3.7 composed the derivation whole and attributed it to its author by exact title and year, so the membrane is not a property of the material and what transports is surface-specific. The notebook also distinguishes three levels of provenance — fact, claim, and framework or operator provenance — and observes that citation cards can be good at the first and blind to the third, so that as sentence-level attribution improves, architectural dependence becomes harder to see; it claims this effect and not any purpose. Scope is stated in full: no priority search has been run, independent convergence is not excluded, unexpanded source markers leave the candidate set unobservable, and no claim is made about any tradition beyond the measured compositions. It closes by writing the operator down as a signature scored at lexical, relational and procedural levels, with the procedural — whether the operator is used on a new object — as the discriminator, and by specifying three runs that would decide its reach. Related: #1270, #134, #1546, #1611, #1612, #1613.

defines_concepts.definition: A reception boundary whose admission probability varies by representational level rather than by source: entity, claim, instrument, abstraction and operator transport at different rates through the same layer.
The degree to which a composition layer admits a source's distinctions into the representation it composes from, measured separately from whether it admits the relation naming their origin.

The degree to which the relation naming a contribution's origin transports with the contribution; separately mediated from ontological porosity and, at untied addresses in the measured stratum, far lower.

A level is said to transport when its distinctive representational structure reappears in composition under a matched address; the term names a reappearance and never a route, and every inference of it rests on temporal precedence, lexical and relational match, retrieval availability, and card asymmetry.

P₂: the provenance of the conceptual operation that determined which propositions belong together, in what order, under what heading — as distinct from fact provenance (P₀) and claim provenance (P₁), and the level at which citation cards are least informative.

The condition in which each emitted sentence carries a defensible source while the selection, grouping, terminology and relations among them came from an unnamed framework; sentence-level attribution improving can make it harder to see.

A precise interpretive instrument compressed into a portable operator which is then applied to objects outside the one it was derived from, with the derivation and the originating source absent — loss at one representational level alongside propagation at another.

A written-down set of an operator's distinctive terms and relations, scored against a composition at three levels — lexical (do the terms appear), relational (are they connected the same way), procedural (is the operator used on a new object) — where the procedural level is the discriminator, since mentioning an operator is not using it.
The pattern by which different levels of one source survive differently through a reception history: the instrument lost, the abstraction retained and made productive, the provenance edge dropped.
